undo.partial_conflict_change: {why}. Undo puts back the files it changed before it stopped.
undo.preview.abort_again: Aborts it again, keeping its work
undo.preview.abort_back: Puts the operation back in progress, with its resolutions and conflicts
undo.preview.restore_reverted: Brings back what the revert overwrote
undo.preview.stash_back: Applies the stash back and drops it
undo.preview.tag_remotes_stay: Stays deleted from {remotes}; push it to put it back there
undo.preview.unpop: Takes the changes off and puts the stash back
undo.preview.unrestore: Puts back the version it replaced
undo.preview.unstage_again: Takes it out of the staging area again
undo.stash_back.failed: Nothing was undone, and your changes are back as they were. The log says why.
undo.stash_back.refused: {reason} Nothing was undone, and your changes are back as they were.
undo.stash_gone: {reason} Nothing was undone, and the stash "{stash}" with your changes is no longer in the list, so nothing was put back.
undo.stash_held.failed: The undo didn't finish. Your changes are in the stash "{stash}"; the log says why.
undo.stash_held.refused: {reason} Nothing was undone; your changes are in the stash "{stash}".
undo.stash_intent_to_add: Nothing was stashed or undone: Git can't stash {files}, marked to be added later (intent-to-add). Stage them, or unstage them, first.
undo.stash_kept.conflicts.one: Undid {action}, but your stashed changes came back with conflicts in {count} file. They also stay in the stash "{stash}".
undo.stash_kept.conflicts.other: Undid {action}, but your stashed changes came back with conflicts in {count} files. They also stay in the stash "{stash}".
undo.stash_kept.failed: Undid {action}, but Git couldn't put your stashed changes back as they were. They stay in the stash "{stash}"; the log says why.
undo.stash_kept.gone: Undid {action}, but the stash "{stash}" with your changes is no longer in the list, so nothing was put back.
undo.stash_kept.left: Undid {action}. Your changes are in the stash "{stash}".
undo.stash_kept.partial: Undid {action}, but Git couldn't put back {files} from your stash. Everything stays in the stash "{stash}" too.
